# FractionalStatisticsPreservation

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The property that anyonic quasiparticles retain their fractional exchange statistics even when edge states are localized or geometrically modified. Ensures that localized edge modes remain usable for robust quantum operations, bridging TCC hardware with neuromorphic-like error-resilient processing.
